name: Modify-column changing column with explicit nonmatching default

payload.shape: A nonpartition table has val0 INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 7 and a secondary index on val0; an online MODIFY COLUMN changes val0 to VARCHAR while concurrent insert/delete workers overlap the backfill apply window.
payload.mutation: Compare ordinary no-default and explicit-default=7 siblings; optionally collapse the live val0 domain to a single value 0 so dependency value and declared default are different for every row.
strong_oracle: table-scan versus FORCE INDEX row count
point lookup for dependency value and declared default
payload.stop_rule: Do not promote a new root from the same transient missing-NOT-NULL signature unless the durable index/table oracle diverges or the fix locus changes.

evidence.signature: table_scan_executor.rs:467 missing data for NOT NULL column (offset = 2)

lessons.method_note: The live lift confirms a user-visible execution failure, while the aftermath oracle prevents overstating it as persistent table corruption.
